SELECT B.BOOKING_ID, B.BOOKING_NO, B.STATUS AS BOOKING_STATUS, BP.NAME AS PASSENGER_NAME, BP.PASSENGER_TYPE, F.FLIGHT_NO, TO_CHAR(F.DEPARTURE_TIME, 'YYYY.MM.DD (DY) HH24:MI', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS DEPARTURE_TIME, DA.IATA_CODE AS DEP_IATA, DA.AIRPORT_NAME AS DEP_NAME, AA.IATA_CODE AS ARR_IATA, AA.AIRPORT_NAME AS ARR_NAME, SC.CLASS_NAME, S.SEAT_NO, T.FARE_AMOUNT, T.CHECKIN_STATUS, TO_CHAR(T.CHECKED_IN_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS CHECKED_IN_AT, TO_CHAR(T.BOARDED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS BOARDED_AT FROM BOOKING B INNER JOIN BOOKING_PASSENGER BP ON B.BOOKING_ID = BP.BOOKING_ID INNER JOIN TICKET T ON B.BOOKING_ID = T.BOOKING_ID AND BP.BOOKING_PASSENGER_ID = T.BOOKING_PASSENGER_ID INNER JOIN FLIGHT F ON T.FLIGHT_ID = F.FLIGHT_ID INNER JOIN ROUTE R ON F.ROUTE_ID = R.ROUTE_ID INNER JOIN AIRPORT DA ON R.DEPARTURE_AIRPORT_ID = DA.AIRPORT_ID INNER JOIN AIRPORT AA ON R.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_ID = AA.AIRPORT_ID INNER JOIN SEAT S ON T.SEAT_ID = S.SEAT_ID INNER JOIN SEAT_CLASS SC ON S.SEAT_CLASS_ID = SC.SEAT_CLASS_ID WHERE B.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND F.IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND BP.NAME LIKE '%' || #{passengerName} || '%'
AND UPPER(B.BOOKING_NO) = UPPER(#{bookingNo})
AND (UPPER(AA.IATA_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{arrivalKeyword}) || '%' OR AA.AIRPORT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{arrivalKeyword} || '%')
AND TO_CHAR(F.DEPARTURE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = #{departureDate}
ORDER BY B.CREATED_AT DESC, T.LEG_TYPE ASC
